pipeline.modality: Humanized aglycosylated anti-KIT (CD117) monoclonal antibody (mast cell depletion)
pipeline.license_origin: Exclusive license from Amgen (HSC clearance use); Jasper-developed for mast cell indications

indications.trial_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 1b/2a evaluating multiple ascending doses (single doses 240mg & 360mg; multi-dose cohorts including 240mg/180mg Q8W) in CSU patients refractory to antihistamines
indications.trial_status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING; positive efficacy and safety data through Q1 2026; planned Phase 2b/3 CSU study being designed
key_milestones: Q1 2026: 240mg/180mg Q8W cohort efficacy data reported

indications.indication: Chronic Inducible Urticaria (CIndU) — cold urticaria & symptomatic dermographism
indications.highest_phase: Phase 1b/2a (SPOTLIGHT completed dosing) + Phase 2 OLE ongoing
indications.trial_design: SPOTLIGHT: Phase 1b/2a open-label, single-dose 40mg/120mg/180mg in 27 CIndU participants; OLE rolls SPOTLIGHT and BEACON patients into 180mg Q8W dosing
indications.trial_status: SPOTLIGHT terminated (study completed); OLE ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING; preliminary OLE data reported Jan 2026 (65% complete/partial response in CIndU)
key_milestones: Oct 2024: positive preliminary data on 40mg/120mg cohorts

indications.trial_design: Double-blind, placebo-controlled single 180mg subcutaneous dose in patients with allergic asthma (14 evaluable: 7 briquilimab vs 7 placebo)
indications.trial_status: TERMINATED on ctgov (study completed dosing/follow-up); LAR-reduction efficacy data reported; further development being evaluated
key_milestones: ETESIAN single-dose Phase 1 completed; data demonstrating LAR reduction at 6 and 12 weeks

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Hematology/HSCT conditioning programs discontinued; Jasper now exclusively focused on mast cell driven diseases

blockers: None — single asset (briquilimab) with three active mast-cell-driven indications; HSC-conditioning programs (SCID, MDS, AML) formally discontinued in 2025.
